0.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_000
0.description: There is still much to do before we can make our next move, and I am sure other duties yet demand your attention.

1.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_001
1.description: If there is nothing else you wish to discuss, I will not keep you.

2.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_005
2.description: The battle for Bozja has begun in earnest, Blade <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>. Already our forces have forced an imperial retreat and taken Utya's Aegis. Should you have time to inspect the camp, Sjeros can escort you.

3.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_006
3.description: Before you leave, is there aught you wish to discuss?

4.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_010
4.description: You have met the new Gunnhildr's Blades, yes? They are without question the finest of our soldiers, and under their leadership morale has never been higher. Victory is in reach, my friend. I can feel it.

5.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_011
5.description: But I digress. If there is naught else, I will leave you to your duties.

6.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_015
6.description: I was no stranger to Misija's grievances, and it was my belief they could be resolved once we reclaimed Bozja. Now... Now I do not know what to think...

7.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_016
7.description: Ahem. But now is not the time to dwell on such things. Is there aught you need?

8.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_020
8.description: Our next incursion will be into Castrum Lacus Litore. We must seize the fortress both to ensure Mikoto's safety and secure a foothold in Bozja. Failure is not an option.

9.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_021
9.description: If you've naught to discuss, I will leave you to your preparations.

10.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_025
10.description: Even now I struggle to understand what happened at the castrum. To lose Gunnhildr's Blades to the IVth Legion... It beggars belief.

11.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_026
11.description: That this may have all been a ploy to afford them time to assemble reinforcements is quite concerning.

12.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_027
12.description: Thankfully we have reinforcements of our own in the Dalmascan resistance, with more on the way from our Far Eastern allies.

13.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_028
13.description: I but pray it will be enough to contend with this new threat. <sigh> For now, we can do naught but rest and regroup.

14.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_029
14.description: I will not keep you, unless there is something you wish to discuss?

15.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_030
15.description: I like not this stalemate with the IVth Imperial Legion. It is only a matter of time before their reinforcements arrive. We must act before their ranks are replenished.

16.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_031
16.description: There is much we wish to discuss with you, though I daresay Bajsaljen could explain it better than I.

17.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_032
17.description: Unless there is aught else you wish to ask, I will leave the finer details of our plan to him.

19.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_040
19.description: It is a relief to see both you and Mikoto returned unharmed. I should certainly hope there was merit in her unprompted excursion onto the front lines.

20.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_041
20.description: But we will speak of that soon enough. Is there something you wished to discuss?

21.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_045
21.description: I dare not ponder what will happen should Misija find a way to wield the full power of Save the Queen. We must stop her before that can happen.

22.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_046
22.description: Is there aught you need, Blade <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>? If not, I will leave you to your duties.

23.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_050
23.description: If Mikoto's vision of the future is true, this may be our only opportunity to apprehend Misija and reclaim Save the Queen.

24.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_055
24.description: The IVth Legion's reinforcements have arrived, and with an imperial warship. Heavens help us...

25.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_056
25.description: I have sent word to Lord Hien for additional reinforcements, but there is no telling when Gabranth's forces will attack.

26.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_057
26.description: Our next battle will no doubt decide the fate of Bozja. I pray we can count on your assistance when the time comes.

27.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_058
27.description: I will leave you to your preparations. Unless, of course, there is something you wished to discuss?

28.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_060
28.description: When the time comes, I trust we can count on you to accompany us to Camp Vrdelnis. If you would speak with Sjeros, he can share with you the location of the outpost.

29.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_065
29.description: Our newly arrived reinforcements from the Far East have already taken to the field. Our debt to them must be repaid with naught less than victory.

30.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_066
30.description: No doubt you wish to join them in the field, yes? I will not keep you, unless there is aught you wish to discuss?

31.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_070
31.description: Lilja tells me the rerouting of aether proceeds apace. A task that would not have been possible, she says, without your timely assistance.

32.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_071
32.description: I trust there are other tasks that yet demand your attention, so I will not keep you. Unless, of course, there is something you wish to discuss?

33.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_075
33.description: If this relic the imperials unearthed is anything at all like the Ultima Weapon Cid spoke of, this bodes ill for the Resistance.

34.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_080
34.description: The time has come, Blade <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>. To put an end to the IVth Legion's schemes and to reclaim Bozja's freedom once and for all. Failure is not an option.

35.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_085
35.description: If you are looking for Mikoto and the others, they have all returned to their respective homes. As you soon will too, I suspect. Though if I may be frank, I believe I speak for many when I say we are reluctant to see you leave.

36.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_086
36.description: Were it possible, I would ask you to stay and help us in the rebuilding of Bozja, but I understand full well other worldly matters likely demand your attention.

37.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_087
37.description: We shall forever be in your debt, Blade <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>. Wherever duty demands you go, know that you always have allies here in Bozja. Farewell.

38.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSCHAK_000_088
38.description: I'll not keep you any longer. Unless, of course, there is aught else you wish to discuss?

40.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_A20_000_000
40.description: Tell me about the IVth Imperial Legion.

41.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_A20_000_001
41.description: Tell me about Legatus Noah van Gabranth.

42.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_A20_000_002
42.description: Tell me about Castrum Lacus Litore.

43.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_A20_100_002
43.description: Tell me about Menenius rem Lanatus.

49.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_A30_000_002
49.description: Tell me about the IVth Legion cavalry and Zealots.

50.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_A30_000_003
50.description: Why do you think she did it?

52.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_200
52.description: The initial invasion of Bozja was led by Basch van Gabranth. There would be a change of commander not long after, however.

53.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_201
53.description: Thirty years ago, during the invasion of Dalmasca, his health took an unexpected turn for the worse, and his son, Noah van Gabranth, oversaw the conquest to its completion. He was a mere twenty years old when he assumed full command.

54.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_202
54.description: The IVth Imperial Legion itself is rather unique compared to most, for the bulk of their forces are not native Garleans, their present leader included.

55.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_203
55.description: Both Noah and his father were quite quick to bend the knee to Emperor Solus, from what I have been told. Perhaps it was that ardent loyalty that helped them rise to such prominence.

56.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_204
56.description: But not all were such fervent followers of the Empire. Quite the contrary, I would hazard the greater part of their soldiers were like us, seeing little recourse but to serve lest they be put to the sword.

57.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_205
57.description: Though I suppose the unwavering loyalty of the IVth Imperial Legion is what serves to set it apart from the rest. Or to be more precise, its loyalty to Noah van Gabranth.

58.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_206
58.description: What's more, you will come to find they are not wont to rely on magitek armaments like most imperial soldiers.

59.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_207
59.description: Indeed, they seem to prefer fighting the old-fashioned way, employing arcane magicks, techniques akin to summoning, and all manner of feral beasts rather than depending on heavy artillery.

60.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_208
60.description: But I fear these will be the least of our concerns, for the battalions en route to Bozja are said to be led by Lyon sas Helsos.

61.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_209
61.description: He is a strategist whose cunning is matched only by his renown as a tamer of beasts, and it is rumored that he alone is worth more than a thousand rank-and-file troops. One might say he has history with the Resistance.

62.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_215
62.description: If reports from our spies are to be believed, his lust for battle and reckless behavior have earned him a demotion to Lyon <hex:021A020203>rem<hex:021A020103> Helsos, meaning Menenius has likely taken his place as commanding officer. I fear this may only encourage the famed tamer of beasts to spend more time in the field, which may ultimately prove to our detriment.

63.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_216
63.description: There is also the mage contingent led by imperial pilus prior Albeleo... The days ahead are fraught with hardship. Of that I have no doubt.

64.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_220
64.description: The IVth Legion's remaining forces are being led by Menenius, allowing Lyon to freely roam the southern front as he pleases.

65.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_221
65.description: And, of course, there is Misija. It will be quite some time before we recover from the losses her betrayal has caused us.

66.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_300
66.description: Ah yes, the leader of the IVth Imperial Legion, one of the youngest to ever take such a position. His father, Basch van Gabranth, served as legatus before him, claiming many a victory in the name of the Empire.

67.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_301
67.description: Basch was a knight of the Republic of Landis, which, like so many other nations, was fast to fall at the hands of the Empire. Rather than die with dignity, he was quite quick to bend the knee to their conquerors, ingratiating himself with the Emperor and earning his place as a legatus.

68.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_302
68.description: This was quite a feat, given that he was not of Garlean blood. One can but imagine the lengths to which he went to earn their trust, but it is clear he labored hard to keep it.

69.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_303
69.description: His health took an unexpected turn for the worse during the invasion of Dalmasca, which afforded Noah the opportunity he needed to rise to prominence. And it was under Noah's leadership that Rabanastre would fall.

70.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_304
70.description: Then, when his father passed two years later, he was named the next legatus of the IVth Imperial Legion.

71.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_305
71.description: Many believe it was the conquest of Dalmasca that earned him the position, but some argue he was appointed on the recommendation of the Emperor, perhaps in recognition of his father's service to the Empire.

72.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_306
72.description: Regardless of the reason, Noah would continue in his father's footsteps. The IVth Imperial Legion would continue to be comprised primarily of foreign soldiers, and their loyalty to the newly appointed legatus was unfaltering.

73.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_307
73.description: One might expect such a legion to remain within the Emperor's good graces, but it would not be so when Varis took the throne. For several years he appointed them to the quelling of uprisings in remote provinces, as if to keep them at arm's length.

74.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_308
74.description: Perhaps he suspected an ulterior motive to the Gabranths seeking to gain such fervent adoration from the IVth Imperial Legion. I have no proof, of course, but one cannot help but wonder...

75.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_400
75.description: It was once known as Alermuc Fortress, erected in the hopes of deterring the Garleans. After the Bozja incident, it would be rebuilt and given a new name─Castrum Lacus Litore.

76.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_401
76.description: Its position to the north of Bozja will make it a critical strategic point in the battles to come. If we are to have any hope of reclaiming Bozja, we must first gain control of the castrum.

77.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_402
77.description: The location was originally chosen for its natural defenses. Being surrounded on all sides by steep cliffs made Alermuc Fortress all but impregnable. Assuming, of course, one had the wherewithal to defend it.

78.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_403
78.description: When the Garleans came, their magitek weaponry was unlike anything we had ever seen. A great many lives were lost in our struggle to hold the fortress, and in the end we were simply outmatched.

79.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_404
79.description: At present, the castrum is held by Legatus Gabranth's second-in-command, Menenius rem Lanatus. An interesting choice, to say the least.

80.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_405
80.description: Lanatus is a well-known family with a long and august lineage. That is, until they incurred the ire of the Emperor, tarnishing their name and robbing them of their position in Garlean society.

81.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_406
81.description: And yet Basch van Gabranth would choose members of their family to serve under him. Mayhap he sensed their desperation to redeem their honor. If that is the case, the road to redemption is long indeed, for two generations of Lanatus have served under the Gabranths.

82.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_407
82.description: Imagine the recognition they would receive for thwarting our attempts to take the fortress. You can be sure he will do all in his power to stop us.

83.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_410
83.description: I was so certain the castrum was ours... How could this have happened?

84.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_411
84.description: So many lives lost for the attempt, and we have naught to show for our struggles. Not even Gunnhildr's Blades...

85.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_412
85.description: Reinforcements will soon arrive from Dalmasca, but I fear even with their strength we will be powerless against Queen Gunnhildr.

86.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_415
86.description: Our plan to retake the castrum seemed without fault, and was executed to the letter. If not for Misija, we would likely be having this conversation there rather than here.

87.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_416
87.description: So many lives have been lost to her treachery...

88.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_417
88.description: My only solace is in the knowledge that Menenius has withdrawn from the castrum. With its defense systems no longer functioning, I suspect he fears heavier losses should we launch another assault.

89.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_450
89.description: At present, the castrum is held by Legatus Gabranth's second-in-command, Menenius rem Lanatus, or I suppose I should say Menenius sas Lanatus, if our intelligence is to be believed. It would appear he was recently promoted to commanding officer of the legion's forces.

90.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_451
90.description: Lanatus is a well-known family with a long and august lineage. That is, until they incurred the ire of the Emperor, tarnishing their name and robbing them of their position in Garlean society.

91.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_452
91.description: And yet Basch van Gabranth would choose members of their family to serve under him. Mayhap he sensed their desperation to redeem their honor. If that is the case, the road to redemption is long indeed, for two generations of Lanatus have served under the Gabranths.

92.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_453
92.description: A curious state of affairs considering the information recently pried from one of our prisoners. You see, Menenius is not of Garlean descent─he is an Elezen. Adoption of a non-Garlean by nobles is unprecedented.

93.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_454
93.description: Only the gods know what inexplicable twist of fate would drive them to do such a thing, but I can understand why they would remain at the side of one who seeks the discarded and otherwise undesirable.

94.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_455
94.description: Menenius serves as their chief intelligence officer, and as you might imagine, the greater part of his time is spent recruiting and dispatching spies, plotting how best to subvert their enemies.

95.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_456
95.description: It yet remains to be seen if Misija was a spy from the start, or if they persuaded her to turn against us, but I have no doubt that what has happened was all according to his plans.

96.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_457
96.description: What I find more concerning, however, is how they are still able to recruit more soldiers to their cause with their empty promises of a new nation.

97.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_458
97.description: We would do well not to underestimate them, Blade <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>. There is no telling what they may attempt next to thwart us.

98.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_500
98.description: I serve primarily as liaison 'twixt the Bozjan Resistance and our allies. I'll not deny there is still much for me to learn, but I will do everything within my power to see Bozja free of the Empire. If that should mean my life, then so be it.

99.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_501
99.description: You...wish to know of my past? It is no different than most, I would imagine─conscription by the Empire, which is the only reason I was not present in the citadel to die alongside my kin in the Bozja incident.

100.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_502
100.description: Some would call it a massacre planned by the Empire, but I am not ready to believe they would willingly kill so many of their own soldiers and engineers.

101.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_503
101.description: Having been raised under the Garlean doctrine, I realize that not all of them are the bloodthirsty monsters many of us would paint them to be. Though the Empire would seek to oppress us, I do not share the same animosity towards its citizens as my Resistance comrades.

102.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_504
102.description: But these are musings better left between the two of us, yes? I would not have the others think me a coward or a traitor to our cause.

103.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_600
103.description: Though we've few resources to spare, I have every intention of investigating Misija and her past, but it will prove a difficult endeavor. Much like me, she has no living relatives, so it will take time to determine what, if any, close acquaintances she had within the Resistance.

104.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_601
104.description: Should we learn anything of import, I will send word to you at once.

105.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_605
105.description: Despite what few resources we have to spare, Bajsaljen has carried out an investigation into Misija and her past. The results were...not what we expected.

106.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_606
106.description: We could find absolutely no inconsistencies in her family or military records. One might say she was lying with the truth.

107.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_607
107.description: From the first, she was one of us. A woman of Bozja... And despite everything that has happened, I believe she is still one of us.

108.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_608
108.description: <sigh> No doubt she would say such naivety is what cost the lives of so many.

109.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_610
109.description: There is so much blood on her hands, and yet I still cannot find it within me to hate her.

110.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_615
110.description: There is so much blood on her hands, and yet I still cannot find it within me to hate her.

111.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_616
111.description: For the interim she will remain in our gaol underground, a guard watching her cell at all times, lest someone seize an opportunity to do her harm.

112.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_617
112.description: Under Bajsaljen's orders, she will face trial after the imperials have been dealt with. I cannot say I agree with his decision to wait, but it is not mine to make.

113.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_618
113.description: Until then, I thought perhaps she might be willing to speak with us, offer intelligence on the enemy to gain some modicum of leniency in her sentencing. Alas, she refuses to talk.

114.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_700
114.description: Ah yes, the <hex:021A020203>Dalriada<hex:021A020103>. It is, without question, the greatest weapon in Gabranth's arsenal. That he would choose to deploy it here shows he has grown desperate to maintain control of Bozja.

115.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_701
115.description: It has not moved an ilm since arriving, fired nary a shot.

116.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_702
116.description: I suspect Menenius is commanding his troops from aboard the warship. All the more reason we must bring it down.

117.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_201_700
117.description: Ah yes, the <hex:021A020203>Dalriada<hex:021A020103>. It was, without question, the greatest weapon in Gabranth's arsenal. That he chose to deploy it there showed he was desperate to maintain control of Bozja.

118.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_703
118.description: According to Bwagi, it was a fleet of warships led by the <hex:021A020203>Dalriada<hex:021A020103> that brought the resistance factions in Rabanastre to a standstill after Doma gained its freedom.

119.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_704
119.description: Ground units managed to disable the barrier protecting the city, and the bombardment that followed razed the city to the ground in minutes.

120.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_705
120.description: That a ship possessed of such power would choose not to engage us deeply concerns me. I cannot help but wonder what might occupy its attention if not us.

121.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_706
121.description: I have no way of knowing for certain, but if it should be that the warship is not able to take action against us, then it would mean now is the time to strike.

122.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_710
122.description: Possessed of such power, I was surprised they did not engage us with the <hex:021A020203>Dalriada<hex:021A020103> before claiming their prize from the ruins. Try as I might, I could not figure out the why of it.

123.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_711
123.description: After the battle, we searched the ship's wreckage for survivors, and the imperial soldiers we rescued, no doubt grateful for our assistance, provided me with an answer.

124.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_712
124.description: If they are to be believed, the <hex:021A020203>Dalriada<hex:021A020103> was not, in fact, armed for battle.

125.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_713
125.description: Was the warship then brought here solely for the purpose of retrieving the Allagan relic? Or was his army merely bereft of resources?

126.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_714
126.description: In the case of the latter, it would not bode well for his forces that struggle even now to maintain their hold on Dalmasca and Nagxia. Perhaps now is the opportunity Lady Fran has been waiting for to rout them once and for all.

127.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_800
127.description: Certainly a most unexpected and formidable addition to the IVth Legion's forces.

128.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_801
128.description: The cavalry are a rather unsettling innovation of magitek technology. They appear to be half-man and half-horse, but are in truth automated weapons requiring no pilot.

129.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_802
129.description: I can scarcely imagine what manner of mechanisms might produce such a monstrosity. I would be lying if I said their appearance was not at all unnerving. It is one thing to encounter death claws on the field, but an entity reminiscent of the Dark Divinity is a wholly different affair.

130.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_803
130.description: Though I suppose the lack of a pilot means one need not show restraint when facing them in the field. By the same token, however, the IVth Legion cavalry knows no fear, nor do they grow tired, making them all the more dangerous.

131.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_804
131.description: That is not to say the IVth Legion Zealots are to be underestimated, of course. From what we can gather, they are a band of heretics who were exiled from Dalmasca prior to the Garleans' invasion. For a time, they were scattered across a number of countries, but eventually consolidated under the banner of the IVth Legion when Gabranth offered them asylum.

132.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_805
132.description: The reason for their exile lies with their faith. You see, they belonged to an obscure faction of the Priesthood of Saint Iocus that worshipped the High Seraph Ultima, in accordance with the Scriptures of Germonique. Their beliefs were deemed heresy, and so they were cast out.

133.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_806
133.description: They are practitioners of the most profane magicks, and are not above sacrificing their own in ritual summonings.

134.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_807
134.description: To do so, they employ relics allegedly bequeathed to them by the High Seraph herself. Regardless of whence they came, there is no denying their power. Contend with the IVth Legion Zealots, and you will inevitably come face-to-face with their demon spawn, the Lucavi.

135.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_900
135.description: Why did she save us? With naught save conjecture to guide me, I know it is not my place to speak of her motives, but she is all that occupies my mind of late.

136.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_901
136.description: She always resented the people of Bozja. The customs and traditions that would forever make her lesser in the eyes of most. Even in her final moments, I suspect her hatred for us yet burned in her breast.

137.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_902
137.description: The others no doubt hate her in kind, but they do not know her as I do. They have not heard the doleful stories of her youth.

138.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_903
138.description: Her childhood was a life of squalor and hunger, digging through garbage for scraps to sell that she might make ends meet.

139.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_904
139.description: For her, Bozja's subjugation was a blessing. They introduced a system of welfare that afforded her the chance to be educated, and ultimately a path to the most prestigious institution of imperial learning.

140.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_905
140.description: It was there, I assume, she was trained in espionage. She told me when we reclaimed Bozja, she wished to be a professor, nurturing brilliant young minds in a new age of peace and prosperity. Despite everything she has done, I still believe a part of her truly longed for that future.

141.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_906
141.description: She sided with the IVth Legion, aye, but it does not change what she believed in─peace, equality, and freedom for those willing to fight for it. And fight she did...

142.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_907
142.description: I believe she remained true to those convictions in the end. One last act in the name of the peace and equality she never knew as a child.

143.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_908
143.description: Indeed, it was an act befitting her lineage, I should think. It was ever the queen's duty, after all, to protect the people of Bozja. But I think she did it not for us so much as for the harmonious future she believed we might achieve.

144.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_909
144.description: Oh, Misija... Though I failed to save you from the darkness, I take solace in knowing the queen's grace could guide you to the light.

145.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_910
145.description: Perhaps if I had been more open with her, if she knew how I truly felt for her─

146.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCMARSCHAK_00658_MARSHAK_200_911
146.description: <sigh> I suppose it's too late to think about that now...
